title: 국방부군사편찬연구소령 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Establishment) The Military History Compilation Institute of the Ministry of National Defense shall be established under the Minister of National Defense to take charge of matters concerning the investigation, collection, and compilation of the history of national defense, military history, and the history of wars.
